programs.description: Viswan, a smuggler, keeps his identity hidden from the new commissioner in town, Chandradas. However, once Chandradas uncovers Viswan's true identity, he starts to track him down.
A man's life takes a turn for the better when he is chosen as an actor while working as an assistant at a theatre troupe.
Subhadra and Ramavarma lead a happy married life. However, things take a turn when Subhadra's music teacher tries to take advantage of her.
Joji, a motorcycle enthusiast, is the youngest son of a well-known man named Kora Sahib. When Joji is falsely accused of murder, he tries to prove his innocence with the support of his father.
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
A young man tries to break away from his poverty-ridden life as a barber's son and hopes to study further. His father, however, refuses to send him away and threatens to commit suicide.
Nakulan and his wife Ganga stay in their ancestral home, which is allegedly haunted. Later, when mysterious events occur, Nakulan calls a psychiatrist to investigate.
Doctor Nandakumar lives with doctor Anantha Padmanabhan and his mother. However, when Nandakumar administers the wrong treatment to a patient, Anantha steps in to rectify the situation.

When the past of a middle-aged unmarried businessman confronts him, it affects his unusual romantic relationship with a younger girl.
